title: Revisited
summary: 14 years, 9 months, and 2 days since our thread for Mississauga City Centre's One Park Tower was last updated, a new photo shows that this striking 38-storey condominium building still cuts a dramatic figure on the local skyline just west of Square One. The Kirkor Architects Planners-designed tower was conceived as a modern take on the buildings that ring New York's Central Park, with a particular emphasis on its crown, which never looks better than at night, lights positioned to accentuate its acute angles.
